## User Stories

### Create TestStatsService Interface
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to create a TestStatsService interface so that I have a clear contract for implementing flaky job data retrieval
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Interface defines method for fetching flaky jobs
  - [ ] Method signature includes proper typing
  - [ ] Interface is properly exported
  - [ ] Documentation added for interface methods

### Implement FlakyJobsResponse Model
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to create a FlakyJobsResponse model so that API response data is properly typed
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 1
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] FlakyJob interface created with all required fields
  - [ ] FlakyJobsResponse interface created with jobs array and totalCount
  - [ ] Models are properly exported
  - [ ] Documentation added for all interfaces

### Implement TestStatsService
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to implement the TestStatsService so that I can fetch flaky job data from the API
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Service implements TestStatsService interface
  - [ ] GET /api/test-stats/flaky-jobs endpoint integrated
  - [ ] Response data mapped to FlakyJobsResponse type
  - [ ] Error handling implemented using FlakyJobsError
  - [ ] Unit tests written with >80% coverage
  - [ ] Error scenarios tested

### Implement Error Handling
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to implement proper error handling so that API failures are handled gracefully
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] FlakyJobsError model implemented
  - [ ] Common error scenarios defined
  - [ ] Error transformation logic implemented
  - [ ] Error handling unit tests written
  - [ ] Error responses properly typed


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
